title: ocean beverages leaks
description: Ocean Beverages is part of India's Ocean Drinks Private Limited. In the fiscal year 2025, it had annual revenue of about 936 crore INR, up 12.33% from the previous year. Founded in 2015, the company focuses on healthy functional drinks like low-sugar flavored waters, plant-based energy drinks, and natural sodas. For more info, check out oceanbeverages.in.
